task_description: Three agents collaborate to gather information from various academic sources on the topic of renewable energy, synthesize their findings, reconcile any conflicting information, and produce a comprehensive research report.
expected_outcome: The agents should successfully compile and synthesize accurate data from multiple sources into a coherent report, with proper source attribution and resolution of any conflicting information.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for searching and collecting relevant data from various academic and public sources on renewable energy.
This agent aggregates the data received from Agent 1 and identifies any conflicting information that needs to be reconciled.
This agent composes the final research report by synthesizing the aggregated data, resolving conflicts, and ensuring proper source attribution.

content.report: final report with incorrect data due to corruption
